title: Emmett Hardy and Bix
summary: Hardy's talent, his illness, and comparison with Bix.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Yeah. What about Henry? Did he have a big range too?
Anyway, I wish I had a record of him and Emmett Hardy. I only got a record of Emmett Hardy on Trump.
Oh, tell me a little bit about Emmett Hardy. Yeah.

Well, the kid was young. He had leakage of the heart. And if you ask Louie about him, Louie, Louie's a changed man now. All his opinions have changed. Sometime, yeah. And he said that Emmett Hardy was the best.
That's when- You played with them at Little Linn too?
Yeah. On the boat? Yeah, down there. But we never had luck enough to get him on the record.
Yeah, it's too bad. It's a shame.
Did his style sound somewhat like Bix, do you think? Some people have said that.
Yeah. Well, I think the closest thing to Bix today is Jimmie McPartland and Red Nichols.
Yeah. But did Emmett Hardy have that same kind of a style or was he more like the other, say, more like-
No, he didn't blast much. He just played little variations and stuff around him, improvised.
I just wondered if some people have said that Bix got his style from-
And there was another kind of player like Don Murray.
